text.card: A red giant 3,786 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.88 solar masses and 8.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,822 K at its surface.
